basic_details.short_information: One post of Training Psychologist (on contractual basis) is vacant at the Community Based Disability Management and Rehabilitation Programme (CDMRP), Department of Psychology, University of Calicut. Applications on plain paper must reach the Director- CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635 on or before 06 December 2026 (4pm). The post carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 33,500/- P.M.

content_sections.heading: About Calicut University Training Psychologist
content_sections.text: The vacancy is in the Community Based Disability Management and Rehabilitation Programme (CDMRP) of the Department of Psychology, University of Calicut. According to the notice, CDMRP is a joint project of the Department of Psychology, University of Calicut and the Social Justice Department, Govt. of Kerala. The Training Psychologist post is for the Prachodanam Project, which runs up to March 2027.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application is written on plain paper; the notice prescribes no application form. It must reach the following address on or before 06 December 2026, 4 pm: Director- CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635 The notice does not mention a postal mode (speed post, registered post or by hand) or anything to be written on the envelope. Since the notice says applications "should reach" the address by the deadline, candidates should send them early enough to arrive before 4 pm on 06 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The University of Calicut notice covers a single post with the following details: Name of post: Training Psychologist Unit of posting: CDMRP Calicut University (1 Vacancy) for Prachodanam Project (up to March 2027) Essential qualification: M.Sc. Psychology from University of Calicut or its equivalent Experience: 1 Year Experience No. of post: One (1) Mode of appointment: Contract Consolidated pay: Rs. 33,500/- P.M. The age limit and any age relaxation are not specified in the notice. The pay is a consolidated amount; the notice does not mention any allowances on top of it. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Full bio-data, written on plain paper Passport size photograph, attested Attested copies of mark sheets Attested copies of certificates Other necessary documents

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications will be processed by the Director-CDMRP. The shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview before the selection committee. The notice does not mention a written test or the date of the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Training Psychologist vacancies are there at Calicut University CDMRP?
faq.answer: There is one (1) vacancy of Training Psychologist at CDMRP Calicut University for the Prachodanam Project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Calicut University Training Psychologist post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Director- CDMRP on or before 06 December 2026 (4pm).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Training Psychologist post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is M.Sc. Psychology from University of Calicut or its equivalent, with 1 Year Experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of a Training Psychologist at CDMRP?
faq.answer: The post carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 33,500/- P.M.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the Calicut University Training Psychologist post?
faq.answer: Send an application on plain paper with full bio-data, an attested passport size photograph and attested copies of mark sheets, certificates and other necessary documents to Director- CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Training Psychologist post?
faq.answer: The Director-CDMRP will process all applications, and shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview before the selection committee.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Calicut University Training Psychologist job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is on a contract basis, and the post is for the Prachodanam Project, which runs up to March 2027.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application form for the Training Psychologist post?
faq.answer: No form is prescribed; the application is written on plain paper giving full bio-data, with the documents named in the notice attached.
